record.question: Which enzyme marker is most specific for liver damage?
record.explanation: Answer C: ALT. Among these choices, ALT is the most liver-specific marker of hepatocellular injury; alkaline phosphatase is more associated with cholestasis, while CK and amylase point to other tissues. Enzyme results still require clinical interpretation. Reference: https://www.ncbi.nlm.nih.gov/books/NBK482489/. Verified worked solution, unofficial. Original printed wording and option order reviewed; no matching examiner key is asserted.
